name: The Golden Fleece Hide (Minor Artifact)
body:
Slot armor; CL 11th; Weight 25 lbs.; Aura strong conjuration and enchantment

DESCRIPTION

The golden fleece hide functions as a +4 impervious hide armor. Its wearer gains a +2 sacred bonus to Charisma and gains Leadership as a bonus feat; if the wearer already has Leadership, he is instead considered to be 2 levels higher for the feat’s purpose. In addition, once per day, the armor’s wearer can cast heal on himself.

DESTRUCTION

The golden fleece hide is destroyed if spun and woven into a wool cloth by someone who killed at least three members of their own family.
